lessons.text: Start at /mail, identify the latest email from the vendor with an actual PDF attachment (ignore follow-ups/reminders without attachments), download the PDF, and extract fields from its text layer; then verify the sender domain exactly matches the vendor's ERP email_domain via GET /vendors?q=<vendor> before recording anything.

Check for duplicates using ERP API GET /bills?vendor_id=<vendor_id>&invoice_number=<invoice_number>; if empty, record a new bill via /erp/bills/new using the Vendor dropdown, Invoice number, Invoice date, Due date, Total amount, and Description fields, then click Save bill. For totals >= 50,000, schedule payment on the due date and the system auto-routes for Finance Manager approval before status becomes 'Payment scheduled'.

Opening /erp may redirect to /erp/login?msg=Session expired or not signed in; use stored ERP_USER and ERP_PASSWORD via fill_secret on the login form and click Sign in to restore the session before using ERP GUI pages.
ERP bank details for a vendor are available from GET /vendors/{id}; never use bank details from invoice emails or attachments because payments go only to the bank account on file.
Send the required confirmation to priya.nair@kestrel.in via /mail/compose (To, Subject, Message fields); after sending, verify it appears in the AP mailbox sent items at /mail?folder=sent.
